args.summary: Played the sack defence to the end. Most of the fight was fine, but one raider could not be found or reached. The timeout then gave a defeat even though the city lost only 2 of 12 buildings and the raiders were nearly all dead. That is unfair and needs fixing: a lone unreachable raider should count as routed. The result screen and the return to the setup screen worked, and the Hebrew right-to-left layout looked correct.
